description: Retrieval evaluation set for the MindEvidence Lab corpus. Each query names the document that should be retrieved and terms that must ALL appear in a relevant passage (a chunk is 'relevant' when it belongs to an expected document and contains every term). Relevance rules were written by hand from the source PDFs and are checked against the stored chunks by `python -m app.retrieval eval --validate`. This is a small hand-made set meant to catch regressions; it is not a benchmark of general retrieval quality.
